decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site Location Plan and Design and Access Statement Received: 21 December 2015, unnumbered existing site location plan, unnumbered existing site plan, unnumbered existing ground floor plan, unnumbered existing first floor plan, unnumbered proposed first floor plan, unnumbered second floor and loft space, unnumbered proposed roof plan, unnumbered existing south east (front) elevation, unnumbered existing south east (front) elevation (second viewpoint), unnumbered proposed south east (front) elevation, unnumbered existing north east (side) elevation, unnumbered proposed north east (side) elevation, unnumbered existing north west (rear) elevation, unnumbered proposed north west (rear) elevation, unnumbered existing south west elevation and unnumbered proposed south west elevation Received: 3 February 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side  elevation walls of the extensions hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The window formed in the side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a first floor side extension with rear roof dormer to the house
